## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Kraków, Poland. It starts at 1 plac Wolnica.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Originally a modest collection curated by Seweryn Udziela, the the Krakow Ethnographic Museum now boasts an impressive 80,000 showpieces, most hailing from the late 19th century to the early 20th century.
>
> This treasure chest of Krakow's peasant culture and folklore flings open its doors to curious minds keen to explore its extensive collections, and to learn how Polish culture has evolved over the centuries.
